title: Eufy Security Event Battery Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eufy:security battery_pct=*
| stats sum(battery_pct) as total_value, avg(battery_pct) as avg_value by device_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks device values by total and average battery percent across Eufy security event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `battery_pct` values for each Eufy security event event and review total and average battery percent by device.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total battery percent.
grandmaExplanation: It quickly which device shows the biggest battery percent numbers in your Eufy security event data.
